zotero.abstractNote: Version 4.0 of the Gravitational-Wave Transient Catalog (GWTC-4.0) adds new candidates detected by the LIGO, Virgo, and KAGRA observatories through the first part of the fourth observing run (O4a). We report 189 gravitational-wave candidates, including 183 binary black hole mergers, 4 binary neutron star mergers, and 2 neutron star-black hole mergers. We provide updated population parameters and discuss the implications of these new detections for our understanding of compact object formation and evolution.
